blocks.orig: The Salinero Serengeti Tented Lodge lies beautifully in the Seronera Valley in the middle of the Serengeti National Park, where it faces the Warangi River to ensure the best year-round game viewing. From April to June, you might even witness the Great Migration passing. The 12 spacious tents are built on wooden platforms and provide all the modern comforts of home. Enjoy the area’s peace from your private veranda with safari chairs or delight your tastebuds in the dining/lounge tent with freshly prepared meals. Weather permitting, you can join the other guests at night for a round of safari story-telling by the campfire.
blocks.html: The Salinero Serengeti Tented Lodge has a beautiful setting in the Seronera Valley, in the heart of Serengeti National Park, facing the Warangi River for the best game viewing throughout the year. Between April and June, you may even see the Great Migration go by. The 12 roomy tents stand on wooden platforms and offer all the modern comforts of home. Enjoy the area’s tranquillity from your private veranda with safari chairs, or treat your tastebuds to freshly prepared meals in the dining/lounge tent. When the weather allows, you can join fellow guests in the evening for safari stories around the campfire.
